scope: ISO 32000-2:2020 EC3 §11.6.5.1 / Table 142 soft-mask dictionary cells, plus §11.6.4.3 graphics-state SMask None/reset semantics. This is a cell/assertion audit, not certification of all transparency behavior or image soft-mask dictionaries.

primary_source.clause: §11.6.5.1 prose is on physical p. 433 / printed p. 418; Table 142 itself begins on physical p. 434 / printed p. 419. The immediately preceding §11.6.4.3 None rule is physical p. 432 / printed p. 417.
primary_source.annotation_review: Inspected primary PDF page annotation objects on physical pp. 432–434 with pikepdf. These pages have navigation Link annotations only; no editorial StrikeOut, Caret, Text, or other EC3 review annotations affect the assigned rules. The PDF footer on physical p. 434 reads printed 419.

table_cells.source_rule: Optional; when present it shall be /Mask.
table_cells.implementation: soft_mask::read does not depend on /Type; it reads /G, /S, /TR, and the group /CS.
assertions: crates/pdf-model/tests/image_masks.rs::a_stencil_under_the_graphics_states_soft_mask_is_drawn_through_both (valid public GS soft-mask dictionary omits /Type and yields literal masked/unmasked cells)
table_cells.assessment: Optional omission has a valid public consumer witness; existing rendering output makes acceptance observable. No separate test drafted.

table_cells.source_rule: Required; /Alpha uses group alpha and disregards color; /Luminosity converts computed group color to one luminosity value.
table_cells.implementation: soft_mask::read selects SoftMaskKind::Alpha or luminosity(...); the latter obtains the group's own /CS and derives its compositing route.
assertions: transparency_foundations_current parent-review: empty Alpha and alpha-transfer tests passed
table_cells.assessment: Independent expected pixels discriminate the two modes; the Alpha case uses same-color regions with different alpha, while luminosity uses different gray values.

table_cells.source_rule: Required stream, a transparency-group XObject. For /S /Luminosity, its group attributes shall include /CS defining the compositing space.
table_cells.implementation: soft_mask::read requires a stream /G, reads /Group /CS, and passes the group to content/transparency/soft_mask.rs for execution.
assertions: soft_masks.rs exact-xref fixtures exercise a Form transparency group through gs and rendered pixels
table_cells.assessment: Public consumer coverage proves group execution and color-space behavior in selected routes, not every possible group attribute combination.

table_cells.source_rule: Optional color backdrop, consulted only for /Luminosity. It has n numbers for the group's /CS component count; absent means that color space's initial value representing black.
table_cells.implementation: soft_mask::backdrop_values resolves numeric components and uses the stated /CS family's initial color when absent or when the supplied array does not resolve to the space's component count. Luminosity setup supplies the backdrop to compositing and outside-BBox values.
table_cells.assessment: Covers explicit and absent backdrops, one- and four-component spaces, and the Alpha-only irrelevance. Component-count fallback on malformed arrays is recovery behavior, not a valid-input conformance claim.

table_cells.source_rule: Optional one-input/one-output function; input and output are in [0,1], out-of-range output is clamped to nearest endpoint. /Identity may stand for the identity function; default is Identity.
table_cells.implementation: soft_mask::transfer resolves missing/null and /Identity to no table; otherwise evaluates and samples 256 inputs, clamps outputs, and rejects an evaluation fault rather than silently treating it as identity.
table_cells.assessment: Independent literal pixels cover default vs explicit Identity, Alpha and Luminosity transfer, outside-BBox input, and both clamp boundaries. These do not exhaust every function type or numerical sampling precision.

state_reset.source_rule: §11.6.4.3 physical p. 432 / printed p. 417: graphics-state /SMask /None means no mask, removes an existing mask, and therefore supplies implicit 1.0 everywhere; q/Q restores graphics state per §8.4.
state_reset.implementation: soft_mask::entry_with_output_intent maps /None to SoftMaskEntry::None; content/ext_gstate.rs installs the returned state; graphics-state save/restore owns q/Q behavior.
state_reset.assertion_detail: Two exact-xref PDF fixtures compare a zero-valued mask with a second ExtGState applying /SMask /None before the mark; literal pixels distinguish masked from solid output. The q/Q operators bracket the state in the fixture, but the current assertions do not paint after Q and therefore do not test restoration.
state_reset.scope_limit: Does not certify image-dictionary /SMask precedence; image masks are a distinct §11.6.5.2 feature reviewed elsewhere.

overall: Selected Table 142 cells have substantial public pixel-level witnesses with independent literal expectations and controls. No high-value uncovered valid-input branch was identified in the assigned subset; no test draft is proposed.
residuals: No exhaustive Type 2/3/4 function matrix or exact error-policy certification.
Malformed /BC component-count behavior is not promoted as a normative requirement.
No GPU backend execution was performed in this shard; parent/other audits own backend parity.
Not a complete §11.5, §11.6, image-soft-mask, or transparency-group certification.
